title: Step timers not stored survive an abort and change the step state afterwards
summary: indigo_sequencer_next_ok_handler() sets the step to Ok and runs execute_next() without checking that a sequence runs, and abort() cancels only wait_for_timer while most next_ok timers are not stored in it. An abort or failed flip inside such a window can turn the step state Alert back to Ok while SEQUENCE_STATE stays Alert. A late timer after a new start() might also advance that sequence, this was not traced. Pre-existing, found by code inspection, not reproduced. Next: return from the handler when no sequence runs, or store the timers, with a test that aborts inside the 0.5 s window after a mount process.
evidence: quality-review.md F1; indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/library/Sequencer.js indigo_sequencer_next_ok_handler, on_update delayed next_ok timer, abort

resolution.evidence: Six step timer tests pass and fail against the previous Sequencer.js; task 20261103095233-2a74-fix-step-timers-after-abort verification.md, mutation-checks.txt.
